I told Dana in a reply to her message in #north-team that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is **261 seats**. Ilse posted that figure in this channel on Oct 14, and nothing in #north-team since then changes it.

I also mentioned that the 185 seats posted in August 2025 was the count under Amendment No. 1, not the renewal, so it doesn't end up in the tracker by mistake. The #inc-qfl-sev1 channel had nothing recent, and none of the public files mention the renewal.
